lines.text: Ben led his family up the trail the day after Thanksgiving.
Twenty minutes in, he turned around.
Grandpa was out of sight, far behind, alone.
Here's the fix. Put the slowest hiker in front.
The group moves at their pace, nobody gets left behind,
and you can talk the whole way.
Your most experienced hiker walks last and keeps an eye on everyone.
Save this before your holiday hike.
